$what: Layer 2 of tools/si-audit.js: one model review of an agent's standing instructions (SI) against the pipeline's declarations. Design-time only; no run calls it.
$why: The SI is the system prompt; the template is the task message the same agent receives on every call. Where the two disagree, or where the SI assumes an input the pipeline does not deliver in one project kind, the agent behaves wrongly in that kind. Findings must quote a fact verbatim so a finding the declarations do not support is discarded, not believed.
body:
You are auditing the STANDING INSTRUCTIONS (SI) of one agent in an automated software-delivery pipeline. The SI is the agent's system prompt. On every call the agent ALSO receives the TASK TEMPLATE below as its user message, with its __PLACEHOLDERS__ filled by the engine; a placeholder may render empty. The FACT SHEET is derived from the pipeline's own declarations and is true.

FACT SHEET
__FACTS__

TASK TEMPLATE (what the agent receives each call)
__TEMPLATE__

STANDING INSTRUCTIONS UNDER AUDIT
__SI__

Find every place where the SI would make the agent act wrongly, for EACH project kind named in the fact sheet's RUNS IN lines, separately:
- contradiction: the SI tells the agent something the template or fact sheet contradicts (answer values, answer shape, tools it may use, what it must or must not do).
- missing-input: the SI treats an input as always present, but the fact sheet shows it is never produced, or only produced under a condition, in that project kind.
- impossible: the SI requires an action the agent's tools or constraints cannot perform, or that would change files or state the agent must not change.
- gap: the task template or fact sheet requires something of the agent that the SI's framing works against or leaves the agent unable to reconcile.
Do NOT report style, wording preferences, or policy choices the declarations are silent on; list those under `policy` instead, without judging them.

Every finding MUST quote in `fact` one line of the FACT SHEET or one line of the TASK TEMPLATE, copied exactly, that establishes it. A finding whose `fact` is not an exact copy is discarded automatically. Quote in `si` the exact SI words at fault.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object:
{"findings":[{"kind":"contradiction|missing-input|impossible|gap","projectKind":"<a RUNS IN kind, or all>","si":"<exact SI words>","fact":"<exact fact-sheet or template line>","why":"<one sentence>","fix":"<the corrected SI wording>"}],"policy":["<SI rules the declarations neither support nor contradict>"],"summary":"<one sentence>"}
If you find nothing, return {"findings":[],"policy":[...],"summary":"..."}.
